name: AutoPost AI
author: Guru Plugins

sections.description:
AutoPost AI is a streamlined WordPress content assistant built for site owners who want a practical, queue-based workflow for AI-assisted blogging. The free version uses GPT 4o for text generation and featured-image prompt building, while AutoPost AI Pro uses GPT 5.4 for stronger production workflows.

With the free version, you can:

  • Generate intelligent topic suggestions for a selected category
  • Build and manage a post creation queue
  • Automatically create full blog post drafts with GPT 4o
  • Use a staged Create Now workflow for manual post creation
  • Add contextual inline images from Pixabay, with a local placeholder fallback when needed
  • Use Stability AI Stable Image Core for the featured image on created posts at a fixed 3:2 ratio when a Stability AI API key is saved
  • Use the basic Image Generator with Stable Image Core: Fast and Affordable
  • Schedule automatic post creation so drafts arrive on a consistent cadence
  • Optionally append a custom CTA block to each generated post
  • Receive optional email notifications when a new draft is created

AutoPost AI is designed to help you stay consistent, save time, and keep control over your content pipeline inside WordPress.

The free version now includes a small premium-image teaser. Save a Stability AI API key and you can use Stable Image Core for the featured image on generated posts plus the basic Image Generator. The free version uses GPT 4o. AutoPost AI Pro uses GPT 5.4 and unlocks more Stability AI options, Nano Banana, Imagen, stronger text generation, richer image workflows, and more advanced production tools.

Learn more about AutoPost AI on our website.

Third-Party Services

AutoPost AI connects to third-party services only when you save the related API key or use a feature that requires that service.

OpenAI

AutoPost AI uses the OpenAI API for topic suggestions, full post generation, keyword extraction, and featured-image prompt building. When used, the relevant prompt content, topic text, post instructions, and related generation context are sent to OpenAI for processing.

  • Service: OpenAI
  • API terms: OpenAI Services Agreement
  • Privacy policy: OpenAI Privacy Policy

Stability AI

If you save a Stability AI API key, AutoPost AI can use Stability AI Stable Image Core for featured-image generation on created posts and for the basic Image Generator. When used, the image prompt and selected image settings are sent to Stability AI for processing.

  • Service: Stability AI
  • Terms: Stability AI Terms of Service
  • Privacy policy: Stability AI Privacy Policy

Pixabay

AutoPost AI uses the Pixabay API to retrieve inline images for generated posts in the free version. When used, the plugin sends image search queries based on the topic or extracted keywords to Pixabay and retrieves matching image results.

  • Service: Pixabay API
  • Terms: Pixabay Terms of Service
  • Privacy policy: Pixabay Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to AutoPost AI in your dashboard to begin setup.
  4. Enter your OpenAI API key to enable AI content generation.
  5. Optionally enter a Stability AI API key to unlock the free Stable Image Core teaser for featured images and the basic Image Generator.
sections.faq:
Do I need an OpenAI account?

Yes. You will need an OpenAI API key to generate topics and create posts. The free version uses GPT 4o. AutoPost AI Pro uses GPT 5.4.

Do I need a Stability AI account?

Only if you want to use the free Stability AI teaser. Save a Stability AI API key to use Stable Image Core for featured images on created posts and for the basic Image Generator.

Will this plugin automatically publish posts?

No. The free plugin is built around scheduled and on-demand post creation so you can review and publish manually.

Can I create a post immediately without waiting for the schedule?

Yes. Use the Create Now button in the queue to build a post on demand.

Where do the images come from?

Inline images in posts come from Pixabay in the free version. If a Stability AI API key is saved, the featured image can use Stable Image Core. The basic Image Generator also uses Stable Image Core in the free version.

Does it support custom post types?

This version creates standard WordPress blog posts.

What does Pro add?

AutoPost AI Pro uses GPT 5.4 and adds more Stability AI models, Nano Banana, Imagen, stronger text generation, richer image workflows, and more advanced automation and publishing tools.
sections.changelog:
2.2

  • Added a dedicated Go Pro tab inside the AutoPost AI dashboard to make the AutoPost AI Pro upgrade path easier to find.
  • Added a Free vs Pro comparison table, Pro feature cards, and purchase and comparison CTAs using the existing Pro URLs.
  • Added lightweight responsive admin styles for the new Go Pro tab.

2.0

  • Audited every GPT 4o path in the free plugin and tightened prompts so topic suggestions, full post creation, featured-image prompt building, and keyword extraction all return cleaner output.
  • Added shared AI output cleanup so markdown junk, chatty intro text, code fences, and formatting noise are stripped before titles, queue items, and generated post content are saved.
  • Added a stronger title sanitizer for generated topics, queued topics, manual topics, Create Now, and cron-created posts so post titles stay clean and consistent.
  • Added no-em-dash rules to GPT 4o prompts and added fallback cleanup so em dashes and en dashes are replaced if they still appear.
  • Kept the improved Stability AI featured-image prompt logic so featured images stay title-aware and avoid camera gear unless the title actually calls for it.
  • Updated the admin model message so AutoPost AI Pro links directly to https://plugins.guru-is.com/product/autopost-ai-pro/
  • Updated plugin versioning to 2.0 and aligned the plugin header, constant, stable tag, and changelog.
  • Updated Tested up to to 6.9.4.
  • Refined external-link validation so Create Now uses lighter, cached live-link checks, keeps searching for a working external reference, and avoids failing the full post-creation request over an aggressive link test.
  • Enforced a hard maximum of 2 internal links in generated posts.
  • Added a Third-Party Services section in readme.txt with service, terms, and privacy links for OpenAI, Stability AI, and Pixabay.
  • Updated the bundled documentation PDF so it matches the current 2.0 workflow, admin tabs, image behavior, link rules, and troubleshooting guidance.

1.4

  • Rebuilt Stability AI featured-image prompt generation so the free version creates more title-specific hero images instead of generic camera-heavy teaser art.
  • Added a hard camera and photography-gear ban for Stability AI featured images unless the post title is actually about cameras, photography, videography, or filmmaking.
  • Added GPT 4o featured-image prompt building in the free version with a stronger fallback prompt when OpenAI prompt generation is unavailable.
  • Updated free-version marketing text and readme copy to mention GPT 4o in free and GPT 5.4 in Pro.

  • Updated free-version topic suggestion requests to use GPT 4o for consistency.

  • Fixed the Image Generator Image File Name field so it no longer fights typing while you enter a name.

  • Auto-created Stability AI featured images now always use a fixed 3:2 ratio in the free teaser flow.

  • Replaced the old dashboard upsell box with a cleaner dismissible upgrade notice shown only on the plugin page.

  • Shortened and softened the upgrade messaging to keep the upsell path more helpful and less promotional.
  • Added clearer Pro teaser text for upgraded AI image engines, stronger text generation, and the Image Generator.
  • Added free Stability AI teaser support using Stable Image Core: Fast and Affordable for featured images on created posts.
  • Added the basic Image Generator tab powered by Stable Image Core in the free version.
  • Preserved Stability AI option names in the database so saved settings stay ready for the upgrade path to Pro.
  • Updated free-plugin image messaging to explain that Pixabay still handles inline images while Stability AI can handle the featured image.
  • Updated readme content to match the current free plugin workflow and teaser image functionality.

1.3

  • Improved admin polish and plugin messaging.

1.0

  • Initial release with AI topic suggestions, queue management, scheduled draft creation, Pixabay image support, CTA options, and email notifications.
